'''Young India Skills University''' was established in [[Hyderabad]], [[India]], under the [[public–private partnership]] model, to help generate [[employment]] opportunities and reducing the skill gap among youth.

== Establishment ==
Young India Skills University was established on 11 October 2024 and will start its operations on 4 November 2024.{{needs update|date=May 2026}}<ref name="yi1">{{cite news |title=Courses at Young India Skills University to commence on November 4; admissions open from Dasara |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/courses-at-young-india-skill-university-to-commence-on-november-4-admissions-open-from-dasara/article68744587.ece |access-date=19 October 2024 |work=The Hindu |date=11 October 2024 |language=en-IN}}</ref> The university was set up to focus on generating the employment opportunities and improving the skill set of the individuals.<ref name="yi3">{{cite news |title=Young India Skills University will play a critical role in reducing unemployment: Telangana IT Minister |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/education/young-india-skills-university-will-play-a-critical-role-in-reducing-unemployment-telangana-it-minister-article-12802859.html |access-date=19 October 2024 |publisher=moneycontrol.com |date=21 August 2024}}</ref> 

[[Anand Mahindra]] from [[Mahindra Group]] was appointed as first chairman of the university, for one year.<ref name="yi5">{{cite news |title=Anand Mahindra appointed chairman of Telangana's Young India Skills University for 1 year |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/anand-mahindra-appointed-chairman-of-telanganas-young-india-skills-university-for-1-year/article68530277.ece |access-date=19 October 2024 |work=The Hindu |date=16 August 2024 |language=en-IN}}</ref>

[[Adani Group]] donated a cheque of Rs 100 crores to the university.<ref name="yi2">{{cite news |title=Adani Foundation donates ₹100 crores towards Young India Skills University in Telangana |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/adani-foundation-donates-100-crores-towards-young-india-skills-university-in-telangana/article68769004.ece |access-date=19 October 2024 |work=The Hindu |date=18 October 2024 |language=en-IN}}</ref>

Logistics company [[Redington Group]] invested around Rs 7 crore for the establishment of a logistics lab at a temporary campus.<ref name="yi4">{{cite news |title=Young India Skill varsity to offer four new courses |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/young-india-skill-university-launches-four-new-in-demand-courses/articleshow/114057569.cms |access-date=19 October 2024 |work=The Times of India |date=9 October 2024}}</ref>

== Memorandum of understanding ==
Young India Skill University had signed a [[memorandum of understanding]] with GMR Hyderabad International Airport Limited to build skill development programmes in the aviation sector.<ref name="yi9">{{cite news |title=GHIAL signs MOU with Young India Skill University, an initiative by the Government of Telangana to enhance skill development for Telangana Youth |url=https://www.airport-suppliers.com/airport_press_release/ghial-signs-mou-with-young-india-skill-university-an-initiative-by-the-government-of-telangana-to-enhance-skill-development-for-telangana-youth/ |access-date=13 April 2025 |publisher=Airport Suppliers}}</ref>

== Courses ==
Young India Skills University launched with three schools: the School of Logistics and E-Commerce, the School of Healthcare, and the School of Pharmaceuticals and Life Sciences.<ref name="yi1" />

It started with six courses<ref name="yi8">{{cite news |title=Six courses at Telangana's Skill University from Dasara |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/six-courses-at-telanganas-skill-university-from-dasara/article68536184.ece |access-date=19 October 2024 |work=The Hindu |date=17 August 2024 |language=en-IN}}</ref> and currently has 17 specialised courses under below heads:<ref name="yi6">{{cite news |last1=Rajeev |first1=M. |title=Telangana's Skills University to offer over 15 courses in different verticals, experts to train youth |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/telangana/telangana-cm-revanth-to-lay-foundation-stone-for-young-india-skills-university-shortly/article68472684.ece |access-date=19 October 2024 |work=The Hindu |date=1 August 2024 |language=en-IN}}</ref><ref name="yi3" /><ref name="yi1" />

* Course for Warehouse Executive and Key Consignor Executive under Logistics and E-Commerce
* Course for Warehouse Finishing Skills in Nursing Excellence under Healthcare
* Course for the Warehouse the Pharma Associate Program under Pharmaceuticals and Life Sciences
* Courses in English and training on soft skills for final year graduate students<ref name="yi10">{{cite news |title=Telangana Skill University to launch English, soft skills initiative |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/telangana/2025/Apr/13/telangana-skill-university-to-launch-english-soft-skills-initiative |access-date=13 April 2025 |publisher=The New Indian Express |date=13 April 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

The university has additionally included four new courses in the field of logistics, medical, health, and pharmaceuticals.

Young India Skills University has tied up with EQUIPPP Social Impact Technologies Limited for skill development courses relating to Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI).<ref name="yi7">{{cite news |last1=Ghosh |first1=Anupama |title=EQUIPPP partners with Skills University for free BFSI training in Telangana, shares dip |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/equippp-partners-with-skills-university-for-free-bfsi-training-in-telangana-shares-dip/article68763897.ece |access-date=19 October 2024 |publisher=BusinessLine |date=17 October 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
